name: ENGR 5510
title: Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship
description: This course is offered in the Fall and focuses on entrepreneurship concepts and approaches such as design thinking, user-centric need and problem identification, and product market fit. The course is taught through an experiential project-based and authentic learning approach using both lectures and student participation and presentations. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher in Engineering and Business and all graduate students in the School of Engineering; instructor consent required.
